messages:
auditor_samantha: Hi team — auditor here, can you provide SOC 2 evidence for RBAC change on service-account rotation (PR #8247), KMS key rotation logs for key alias/"alias/redwood-prod", and vulnerability triage notes for CVE-2025-XXXX? Need control mapping to CC6/CC7 by EOD.

 tanya: Hi Samantha — we'll assemble. Quick Q: do you need full raw logs or sampled time window? :thinking:

 auditor_samantha: Ideally full logs for the window 2025-02-01..2025-02-07, but a tamper-evident export is fine. Need chain-of-custody manifest too.

 mike-sre: I'll export from our logging bucket. Plan: generate Splunk saved search -> export to s3://redwood-evidence/2025-02/audits/6200001111/*.csv, sign with sha256 and add manifest. Will include query.

 julia: For KMS rotation — key alias "alias/redwood-prod" rotated 2025-02-03 03:12 UTC. I'll attach KMS key history (CloudTrail events) and the KMS rotation record. Also include HSM rotation proof from KMS logs.

 audit-bot: Note: evidence package size limit = 2GB. Recommend zipping and uploading pre-signed link expires in 7d.

 mike-sre: Splunk query I'm running: 
``
index=prod_logs source=cloudtrail "kms:RotateKey" OR "UpdateRole" OR "AssumeRole" earliest=2025-02-01T00:00:00Z latest=2025-02-07T23:59:59Z | table _time, user, eventName, resources, requestParameters
```
I'll include full results and also a sample of filtered RBAC change entries.

 tanya: For RBAC PR #8247 — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8247. Approvals: infra@ and secops@. We'll export the GitHub audit trail (push events, approvals) and a signed snapshot of the PR state.

 julia: Vulnerability triage notes: CVE-2025-XXXX impacted package libc-dev on builder images. Mitigation: image rebuild on 2025-02-02, CVE patch applied, canary run passed. I'll attach CVE tickets: RDW-4123 and RDW-4124 and timeline.

 mike-sre: I've uploaded initial files to s3 with manifest and sha256: s3://redwood-evidence/2025-02/audits/6200001111/evidence_bundle_v1.zip; presigned link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/6200001111?X-Amz-... (expires 7d). Manifest file: evidence_manifest_v1.csv (sha256: abc123...).

 auditor_samantha: Thanks — can you also include the mapping of these artifacts to SOC2 CC6 and ISO 27001 A.9 controls? A short spreadsheet is fine.

 tanya: Will do. We'll add control_map_cc6_iso_a9.xlsx to the bundle and send a signed checklist. ETA 3 hours. :thumbsup:

 oncall: pinging eng-oncall to confirm there's no outstanding incidents that would affect these logs.

 oncall: confirmed no incidents in the window. All green.

 auditor_samantha: Perfect. Once I review, I may ask for a live verification session. Thank you all.
